_comment: Where the site shows a feature photo, one entry per place. `photo` is a slug from data/gallery.json (the salon's own photos, 4:5 WebP in img/photos/ at the widths listed there); null shows no photo there (the section keeps its plaster texture and light). To use the owner's new interior photos: add each to data/gallery.json the same way as the others (see docs/PHOTOS.md), then put its slug here. `alt` overrides the gallery description when the place needs different wording. docs/IMAGERY.md lists every place and the photo that would suit it best.
